# yanshi v1.1

Everyday AI development habits: shortest useful path, manual thinking shortcuts, contract-grounded evidence, and project-local lessons. Practices come from the author's article and E2E post; real session examples are still being collected (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Install

Skills CLI (requires Node >= 22.20):
npx skills add Hackerismydream/yanshi -g -a codex -y
npx skills add Hackerismydream/yanshi -g -a claude-code -y

Without Node, Python >= 3.10:
git clone https://github.com/Hackerismydream/yanshi && cd yanshi
python3 scripts/setup.py install --host both
Add --apply after reviewing the plan. Existing destinations cause refusal; add --update to back them up to ~/.yanshi-backup/<timestamp>/ and replace only skills listed in skills.json.

## Names

- yanshi-think: Help me think this through before coding (automatic or by name)
- yanshi-debug: Why is this failing? Help me debug it (automatic or by name)
- yanshi-check: Check this before I submit it; does it actually work? (automatic or by name; read-only by default)
- yanshi-handoff: Prepare a handoff for the next session (automatic or by name)
- yanshi-retro: Capture what went wrong and save the lesson in this project (automatic or by name)
- yanshi-build: Build this and self-test it (manual only)
- yanshi: Use yanshi to move this forward; what should we do next? (manual only)
- yanshi-ask: first | challenge | trim | ablate | boundary thinking shortcuts (manual only)

Use $name in Codex and /name in Claude Code, e.g. /yanshi-ask challenge this plan. The router picks one current moment, not a pipeline. A read-only request does not authorize edits.

## Project memory

Project-facing skills read the target project's .yanshi/INDEX.md if present and only matching active practices. Retro saves only on a request to persist; missing evidence stays candidate, stale lessons become retired.

Opt-in new-session integration, from the clone:
python3 scripts/setup.py project --project <your-project-root>
Preview first; --apply creates the index, adds bounded blocks to the root Codex instruction file and CLAUDE.md, and adds .yanshi/HANDOFF.md and .yanshi/evidence/ to the project's .gitignore.

## Validation

python3 scripts/check.py --self-test
verification.md lists what the checks cover. docs/author-practices.md holds the author's exact quotes; real examples are mostly still empty.
